messages:
Lina: FYI GlacialAI acct suspended by collections automation yesterday even though they say they uploaded a PO. Pasting details from customer email.

collections-bot: [automated] Invoice 2026-03-05-GLA-199 overdue -> service suspended at 2026-03-04 22:17 UTC

Lina: Customer (Anna @ GlacialAI) claims PO# GLA-PO-2026-78 was uploaded on Mar 3 via the billing portal and shows as 'received' in their UI.

Omar: Pulling billing portal and payment logs now.

Omar: Payment gateway logs: card ending 4242, 3 failed attempts, decline code=do_not_honor, last response: AVS mismatch. gateway_id=pg_9a3f7

Sophia: Did they attach the PO to the invoice record or to the org profile? Different flows.

Lina: They say it was attached to the invoice. They also sent a screenshot — I'll drop it in the ticket.

Mike: I found a PO file in S3 for acct_GLA_332 but PO number in the file is 'GLA-PO-2026-078' (extra leading zero). Our matcher normalizes poorly and didn't link it to invoice 'GLA-PO-2026-78'.

Omar: That explains why the reconciliation job still marked invoice unpaid and scheduled card retries -> triggered collections.

Lina: Ugh. Collections-bot suspended per policy after 72h unpaid window.

Sophia: Action items: get PO attached to invoice, stop card retries, request collections hold while we validate.

Omar: Quick remediation: manually attach PO to invoice in billing UI and re-run reconciliation job. Command we use in infra: `/billing reconcile --account acct_GLA_332 --invoice 2026-03-05`

Mike: I'll patch normalization to strip leading zeros and requeue reconcile. Also will set invoice to 'pending_po' to avoid further card attempts.

Omar: Reconcile started. Patch applied to normalization rules (strip leading zeros from PO segments).

Lina: Customer prefers net-30 on PO rather than forcing card retries — they said their issuing bank blocked cross-border attempt.

Mike: Set invoice status to pending_po and cancel scheduled payment attempts. SQL used: `UPDATE invoices SET status='pending_po' WHERE id='2026-03-05';`

Omar: Cancelled scheduled payment attempts for acct_GLA_332.

Sophia: Collections, please hold suspension rollback until invoice status updated.

collections-bot: Hold applied by @sophia_acctexec until 2026-03-05 18:00 UTC

Omar: Reconcile finished, matched PO GLA-PO-2026-78 -> invoice 2026-03-05. Invoice status now `pending_po`.

collections-bot: Reinstatement queued on status change.

Lina: Please confirm when service is back so I can update the customer.

collections-bot: [automated] Service reinstated for acct_GLA_332 at 2026-03-05 09:14 UTC. Please confirm with customer.

Lina: Confirmed with Anna, access restored. Customer grateful. :tada:

Mike: I'll open FIN-412 to add PO normalization and a portal hint about PO formatting to prevent this.

Sophia: Thanks team — closing loop. :white_check_mark:
